title: Scenario Composer
subtitle: Build and run practical attack-defense simulations

attackDescription.dictionary: Attacker tries many common passwords against one/few accounts. Fast and noisy.
attackDescription.credential_stuffing: Uses leaked username/password pairs. More realistic and often higher success.
attackDescription.password_spray: One password attempted across many users to avoid lockout detection.
attackDescription.distributed: Many rotating IPs simulate botnet traffic and bypass naive IP limits.
attackDescription.reverse_brute: Tests many usernames against one known password candidate.

surfaceDescription.login: Focuses on authentication endpoints and account takeover patterns.
surfaceDescription.api: Focuses on token/key abuse and machine-to-machine request pressure.
surfaceDescription.mixed: Combines login and API pressure to model broader SME exposure.

businessDescription.retail: Retail usually has seasonal traffic spikes and high account reset volume.
businessDescription.fintech: Fintech needs stricter lockout, anomaly detection, and audit-quality controls.
businessDescription.education: Education has broad user diversity and frequent credential reuse risk.
businessDescription.saas: SaaS prioritizes login reliability while defending high automation traffic.

education.title: What these options mean
education.teacherNote: Tip: choose profile/surface close to your real environment for useful output.
